# 002-lightweight-pypi-release — Spec

## Overview
Deliver a lightweight release path for the demo package: validation tooling that checks
the artifact before publication, a publication runbook, and post-release verification.
This fixture is a hermetic reproduction of the upstream mission shape — placeholder
identifiers only, zero organization data.

## Outcomes
- A validation tool that any maintainer can run before publishing.
- A repeatable publication flow with a post-release smoke check.
